title: 第12章 洞府夜话第13章 新衣
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 楚安芷踏入赵归涯的洞府，扑面而来的是一股还算能接受的热浪和混合着淡淡的金属煅烧后的气味。
她眨了眨眼，适应着眼前的光线。
整个洞府比她上次来要明亮许多。
待适应眼前光线后，入眼的便是坐在石桌边的赵归涯周身围绕着七个阵文。
阵文上各自选一个铁炉虚影里面都炼着一件衣服。
我勒个七炉同开呀，不愧是邪教头头，一般人的精神力可达不到这个地步。
七个炉鼎虚影在赵归涯周身缓缓旋转，每个炉内都有一件款式相同，但又有些不同的衣物在灵火中沉浮。
他双手结印，十指如穿花蝴蝶般舞动，同时控制着七道不同的灵力流。
额前几缕碎发被汗水浸湿，贴在白皙的皮肤上，在炉火映照下泛着金色的光晕。
“师尊稍等，您先坐会儿。”
赵归涯看见她进来，顺手把他一旁的板凳推了过去，手上指诀还在不断掐着，“衣服雏形马上炼好。”
楚安芷接过板凳，定睛一看。
嚯！
这不就是昨天晚上赵归涯用茶杯和瓜子壳随手练出来的板凳嘛。
她拍了拍那板凳，还挺结实的。
“行，你先忙。”
说着，就把板凳放在地上坐了下去。
楚安芷托腮望着被铁炉虚影包围着的赵归涯。
楚安芷托腮望着被铁炉虚影包围着的赵归涯。
从她这个角度看去，赵归涯的侧脸在跳动的炉火映照下忽明忽暗。
那张平日里总是带着笑意的脸此刻异常专注，薄唇紧抿，琥珀色的眼瞳中倒映着粉紫色灵火，竟显出几分妖异的美感。
“师尊别这么盯着我看，聊会儿天嘛，”
赵归涯突然开口，手上动作不停，“你这么盯着我，怪吓人的，我会分心。”
楚安芷：（T_T）
“咋滴，我说话你就不分心了。”
“还好吧，”
赵归涯一脸谦虚，“只是同时炼几件玄级上品的法衣而已，工序又不是很复杂。
比起被师尊你那种看小白鼠的眼神，这点程度还行。”
竟一时不知道吐槽赵归涯凡尔赛还是他说她的眼神猥琐了。
赵归涯余光看着自家师尊一脸仿佛要打人的表情，连忙扯开话题：“师尊这么晚过来是有什么事儿吗？”
“其实也没什么事闲着也是闲着就过来看看，”
楚安芷双手托着下巴，歪头又想了想，“不过我倒是有件事想问你。”
“同时使用许多瞬移符也就只会造成时空撕裂使人受伤。
但是不会把人砸失忆吧？”
content_en:
When Chu Anzhi stepped into Zhao Guiya's cave, she was greeted by an acceptable heat wave mixed with a faint smell of calcined metal.
She blinked, adjusting to the light.
The entire cave was much brighter than the last time she came.
After adjusting to the light in front of him, what caught his eye was Zhao Guiya sitting at the stone table surrounded by seven formations.
On the formation text, each person chooses an iron furnace phantom with a piece of clothing inside.
I have seven furnaces to open at the same time. I am worthy of being the leader of a cult. The mental strength of ordinary people cannot reach this level.
The shadows of seven furnace cauldrons slowly rotated around Zhao Guiya. In each furnace, there was a piece of clothing of the same style but somewhat different floating in the spiritual fire.
He formed a seal with his hands, and his fingers danced like butterflies through flowers, while controlling seven different streams of spiritual power.
The few strands of broken hair in front of his forehead were soaked with sweat and stuck to his fair skin, glowing with a golden halo under the fire.
"Master, wait a moment, please sit down for a while."
Zhao Guiya saw her coming in and pushed the bench next to him. He was still pinching his hands and said, "The prototype of the clothes will be finished soon."
Chu Anzhi took the bench and took a closer look.
Oops!
Isn't this the bench that Zhao Guiya made casually with teacups and melon seed shells last night?
She patted the bench. It was quite solid.
"Okay, you get busy first."
With that said, he put the bench on the ground and sat down.
Chu Anzhi held her chin up and looked at Zhao Guiya who was surrounded by the shadow of the iron furnace.
Chu Anzhi held her chin up and looked at Zhao Guiya who was surrounded by the shadow of the iron furnace.
From her point of view, Zhao Guiya's side face flickered in and out of light under the beating fire.
The face that usually had a smile on it was extremely focused at this moment, with thin lips pursed tightly, and the pink-purple spiritual fire reflected in the amber pupils, which actually showed a somewhat enchanting beauty.
"Master, don't stare at me like that, let's chat for a while,"
Zhao Guiya suddenly spoke and kept moving his hands, "It's scary for you to stare at me like this. I'll be distracted."
Chu Anzhi: (T_T)
"Hey, you won't be distracted when I talk."
"It's okay,"
Zhao Guiya looked modest, "It's just a matter of refining a few high-grade Xuan-level robes at the same time, and the process is not very complicated.
Compared to the way my master looked at you like a guinea pig, this level is not bad. "
Chu Anzhi: (╬?_?)
I didn't know for a moment whether he was complaining about Zhao Guiya's Versailles or he was saying that her eyes were obscene.
From the corner of his eye, Zhao Guiya saw the expression on his master's face as if he was about to hit someone, and quickly changed the subject: "Is there anything wrong with master coming here so late?"
"Actually, I don't have anything to do, so I just came over and took a look,"
Chu Anzhi held her chin with her hands, tilted her head and thought again, "But I do have something to ask you."
"Huh?"
"Using many teleportation charms at the same time will only cause time and space to tear and injure people.
But it won’t cause people to lose their memory, right? "
title_en: Chapter 12 Night Talk in the Cave Chapter 13 New Clothes
